generation_guards: Show exactly seven penguins and exactly three kangaroos.

Keep the kangaroos visually separate and countable, positioned below the penguins.

Avoid extra penguins, extra kangaroos, or other animals.
Avoid occlusion that hides bodies or prevents counting.

Emphasize the vertical over/under relation and maintain visibility of every animal for reliable counting.
